title: Case studies: AI, industrial automation, enterprise systems — LucrumTech
description: Six products shipped and supported by us — AI platforms, industrial automation, enterprise systems and digital products.
h1: Six products shipped. We support every one.
lede: AI platforms, industrial automation, enterprise systems and digital products.

items.name: InHelper
items.problem: Insurance case processing depended on manual document handling and manual reporting. A single case took days, and the load fell on people who should have been assessing claims.
items.owned: The full platform — architecture through delivery. PDF parsing, call transcription, structured data extraction and automated report generation in one workflow.
items.changed: Processing dropped from days to hours. Reporting accuracy improved and administrative workload fell.

items.name: AMOS
items.problem: Changing automation on a production line was slow and expensive, so the manufacturer effectively couldn't experiment. Every adjustment carried a changeover cost that made iteration uneconomic.
items.owned: An automation operating layer over a cloud IoT backbone. Engineering teams deploy workflow changes to live production systems remotely, adjust logic against real equipment, and monitor execution cycles as they run.
items.changed: Faster deployment, less downtime, better operational visibility. Experimentation that had been too costly became routine.

items.name: Order-to-Execution
items.problem: Production orders were typed into specialised equipment by hand. Manual entry meant delays and recurring errors on the factory floor.
items.owned: A Windows-based automation system that takes validated orders and translates product configurations, sizing specifications and machine parameters directly into machine-ready instructions.
items.changed: Manual operator input was eliminated from the order path, errors fell, and production workflows ran faster.

items.name: Machine Monitoring
items.problem: Most machines on the floor weren't connected to any network. There was no way to see alerts, warnings or throughput without standing in front of the equipment.
items.owned: A monitoring system using IoT cameras to read machine screen output directly — no retrofit, no machine integration — converting alerts and operational indicators into structured analytics.
items.changed: Failures get caught earlier, downtime fell, and operations gained visibility into equipment that had been invisible.

items.name: WhatIf
items.whatItIs: An AI analytics platform for installation advertising — campaign performance analysis, behaviour pattern recognition, conversion analytics and automated recommendations.

items.name: nuMessage
items.whatItIs: A secure communication platform — encrypted messaging and voice on a privacy-first architecture.
